sources.reason: The primary source is my own unpublished lecture-notes draft, so it has no canonical URL. I compared the package against it: the harness near-verbatim detector flags 93 spans, of which 82 are math, table or unit-factor token runs and 11 are prose. Those 11 are data tables, standard definitions, and problem statements I chose to retain from my own notes; the longest is 31 words and none is a reproduced passage of original expression. Evidence: reports/verbatim_scan.md.
